title: Analog Bloom
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small single-pass 180-second stereo master; a continuous 128-second excerpt from 32s forms the station mix and its first 64 seconds form the game mix; -5.5 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Create one original 180-second stereo synthwave instrumental at strict 118 BPM in 4/4 for a family-friendly one-or-two-key rhythm game. By 24 seconds the full energetic groove is present: deep quarter-note kick, crisp backbeat snare, eighth hats, pulsing analog octave bass, warm vintage chords and a distinct short synthesizer lead attack on each quarter beat. Signature hook: three clipped descending notes answered by one long higher note and two short bell tones. Keep 32-to-160 seconds continuously active at stable loudness; change bass roots and lead answer after 96 seconds. Distinctly melodic and bright, with subtle analog texture but no recognizable song quotation. No vocals, speech, samples, tempo drift, quiet bridge, breakdown, fade or silent tail inside the selected section.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original comic-print cover: asymmetrical analog wave petals unfold from a square oscillator node, ivory and cyan with coral phase ticks; no flowers, cassette, sun, instrument, text or person.
